_about: Limits for the ground of the real style, for tools/look.mjs --check: node tools/look.mjs --shots alpine,valley,desert --styles real --check tools/look/ground.json --against tools/look/ground-baseline.json (npm run check:ground runs it after tools/ground_check.mjs). ground-baseline.json is what the same three frames measure in a tree that has no beds in the faces of the land, no normal maps and no rubble (the low tier draws the land the same way): the near, middle and far ground, the cost of the frame, and the edge of the near land. What is held is the ground with them: more to see within 40 m, the middle ground as busy as it was or busier, the far ground no busier, and nothing dearer to draw.

rules.why: the ground within 40 m has texture: the verge and the bank have stones, the wet and the dry of the dirt show (1.4 times measured)
the cut rock within 40 m has joints and beds in its light (1.27 times measured)
the sand within 40 m lies in ripples and glints against the sun (1.3 times measured)
the land from 40 to 300 m has the rock's blocks and beds laid on it, as big as they look from there (1.04 times measured)
the sand's wide ripples and the mesas' beds do not make the middle land busier than it was (up to 0.06, which is a busy land)
the middle land of a meadow and a wood is as it was
the far land (300 to 1500 m) is no more broken up than it was: none of the maps reach it
the far land does not flicker from one frame to the next the car's sixtieth of a second on
the triangles of a frame: the beds push the vertices there are, and rubble is a few hundred stones of eight (0.1% at most, in the valley)
the draws of a frame: the rubble is one mesh
the textures: the rock's and the fine ground's (2 measured)
the programs: the depth of the sun's shadow of the land that has beds, in the real program and in the painted one (1 or 2 measured, as a page goes through the styles)

the edge of the near land is no smoother than it was; the beds push a vertex by at most 0.6 m, a pixel or less at 100 m, so the edge of these three frames does not move by a number that can be told (0.28, 0.83 and 1.24 pixels with them and without)
